correctness.rationale: The anti-commutator identity gives the exact scalar/traceless reduction and at most two nonzero traces. Rank-span cases in the split 3D quadratic space exhaust all trace-free tuples; incidence bundles and explicit generic rank witnesses prove component dimensions and noncontainment. Disjoint rank counts, exact quadratic-form norm-fiber counts and traceful strata produce the point-count formula, with direct finite-field verification in 24 field/arity configurations. Polynomial times exponential independence gives minimal order six. Proof treats reduced varieties, odd characteristic only.

value.rationale: The tuple variety is the natural matrix realization of pairwise skew-commuting generators. A complete dimension/component spectrum for every tuple length, all-arity exact finite-field point count, and sharp fixed-order recurrence are motivated invariants and capture the transition from two to arbitrary generators. These go beyond a routine recomputation of pair or traceless components.
